documents.text: The official Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 fee schedule lists BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering, BS Artificial Intelligence, BS Telecom and Networking, BS Data Science, BS Cyber Security, and BS Robotics and Intelligent Systems together under Information Technology. documents.text: The official admission instructions say fee challans are payable through Easypaisa app, agent, or franchise; KUICKPAY; or any Bank of Khyber branch through CMS. A university account number is not required for CMS. After payment, the application portal should show the challan as Paid. These instructions concern admission fee challans.

The official 2022 undergraduate miscellaneous-charges document states: normal semester fee within five working days after classes commence; normal fee plus PKR 500 from the 6th through 10th working day; plus PKR 1,000 from the 11th through 15th; plus PKR 2,000 from the 16th through 20th; plus PKR 3,000 from the 21st through 30th; and plus PKR 5,000 from the 31st working day until mid-term examinations commence. documents.text: The official 2026 admission schedule publishes fee-submission windows tied to admission merit lists. For BS, BS 5th Semester, and Diploma Phase I, the first merit-list fee window was 27 July through 3 August 2026 and the second was 4 through 7 August 2026. Later BS admission listings show merit-list windows in October 2026. These are admission deadlines, not a currently enrolled student's semester due date; the authenticated student's fee record is authoritative for personal due-date questions.

The official 2022 undergraduate miscellaneous-charges document lists repeating a course to pass or improve, deficiency courses, and bridging courses. Within the normal degree duration, up to three courses cost PKR 3,000 per course; four or more courses require the full semester fee. After the normal degree duration (9th semester onward), up to three courses require a PKR 3,000 semester registration fee plus PKR 3,000 per course; four or more require the full semester fee. Improvement after degree completion has a PKR 5,000 charge for each lapsed semester at the main campus. The document says all charges are subject to change with approval of the competent authorities.

documents.text: The official 2022 undergraduate miscellaneous-charges document lists these main-campus charges: change of department or program PKR 5,000; inter-college migration NOC PKR 1,600; incoming migration or credit-transfer processing PKR 2,500; outgoing migration or credit-transfer NOC PKR 5,000; course exemption PKR 1,000; semester freezing within two weeks of classes PKR 5,000; semester suspension PKR 5,000 per semester. Freezing before mid-term causes 50 percent forfeiture of the semester fee and before terminal examinations causes 100 percent forfeiture. All charges are subject to change by the competent authorities.

documents.text: The official 2022 undergraduate miscellaneous-charges document lists: mid-term make-up examination PKR 500 per course; terminal make-up examination PKR 1,000 per course; re-totaling PKR 1,500 per course; rechecking PKR 1,500 per course; course re-registration due to shortage of attendance PKR 1,000; and relaxation in required attendance PKR 1,000 per percentage point of shortage down to 65 percent. All charges are subject to change by the competent authorities.

documents.text: The official revised graduate charges document lists repeating to pass or improve within the degree duration at PKR 5,000 per course along with the full regular-semester fee. Improvement after degree completion for up to two courses requires PKR 5,000 semester registration, PKR 5,000 per course, and PKR 5,000 for each applicable lapsed semester; more than two courses require the full semester fee. Other published charges include incoming credit transfer PKR 5,000, outgoing credit-transfer NOC PKR 10,000, course exemption PKR 2,000, semester freezing within two weeks PKR 10,000, mid-term make-up PKR 1,000 per course, terminal make-up PKR 2,000 per course, re-totaling or rechecking PKR 3,000 per course, and attendance-related course re-registration PKR 2,000.
